payload.description:
Feature: Unified runtime model controls
  Scenario: Runtime defaults reach LLM-backed ClassifyProcedure
    Given TactusRuntime is configured with reasoning_effort, verbosity, max_tokens, and temperature
    When ClassifyProcedure builds an LLM classifier without local overrides
    Then the underlying LLM model receives those runtime defaults

  Scenario: ClassifyProcedure overrides runtime defaults
    Given TactusRuntime is configured with model defaults
    And ClassifyProcedure declares different values for one or more model controls
    When it builds the LLM classifier
    Then ClassifyProcedure values override runtime defaults
    And omitted ClassifyProcedure values inherit runtime defaults

  Scenario: Existing procedure-local config remains valid
    Given an existing ClassifyProcedure already declares model controls in its config
    When the procedure runs under runtime defaults
    Then the local config keeps the same precedence and behavior
payload.title: Runtime defaults and local overrides drive LLM classification
